title: Jesus in the synagogue at Nazareth
description: Jesus comes to Nazareth where he was raised, enters the synagogue on the Sabbath, and reads from the book of Isaiah: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon me ... to proclaim a year of favor from the Lord." He rolls up the scroll and says that this scripture has been fulfilled today. The people are amazed at first and ask if he is not Joseph's son, but when he reminds them that no prophet is accepted in his hometown and refers to Elijah being sent to the widow in Zarephath and Elisha who cleansed the Syrian Naaman, they become furious. They drive him out of the city to throw him off a cliff, but he walks right through the crowd and leaves.
